original_header_audit.scope_note: Bounded header audit of nine CSV/TSV/TXT files in supplements.zip and Search.zip found no rank/HLA/affinity/binding column. Does not rule out author-held output.

join_invariants: Must retain per-peptide scores/ranks for ALL supplied candidate alleles, including non-best alleles.
Must perform a non-filtering 1:1 join to quantitative response rows without adding binding-based eligibility filters.
Must preserve missing/unsupported lengths explicitly without imputing scores.
Must never alter existing split assignments or discard alternate parent protein origins.
Must never attribute a newly computed derivation retroactively to the original Shapiro 2025 paper.
Must keep genotype, inferred best-allele prediction and measured restriction strictly separate.
